notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 Released
notes.notes: [p]We have released Patch 1.0.1 to improve your gaming experience.[/p][p]Please apply the latest update files before playing.[/p][p]Improvements[/p][p]The language selection displayed when starting a new game has been corrected from “日本語” and “英語” to ‘日本語’ and “English”.[/p][p]We will continue making improvements to ensure you can enjoy Okayu Nyuuum! more comfortably.[/p][p]We appreciate your continued support.[/p]
